cases.title: Legally current participants
cases.positive: The exact seller/importer/exporter and known buyer identities, Market, mandate and scope are current at consequential execution.
cases.negative: Wrong audience, legal actor, tenant, revoked principal or expired mandate refuses execution.
cases.required_evidence: IAM-issued token, CP binding decision and native operation denial.

cases.title: Current native commercial commitment
cases.positive: RFQ/quotation to native Trade order commits only with current seller authority and independently evidenced buyer identity, consent, role, Market, spend and approval. CRM is optional and can propose only; XBN-07 qualifies an actual CRM handoff.
cases.negative: Opportunity marked won, null spend, B2C fallback, self approval, duplicate native write or approval drift denied.
cases.required_evidence: Exact quote/version, capability grant, spend, signed approval, native commit and replay.

cases.title: Scoped immutable transaction correlation
cases.positive: Opaque correlation connects voluntarily disclosed party-local order/invoice/evidence references and remains stable through replay.
cases.negative: Foreign ledger writes, undisclosed private data, mutable source object, identifier guessing and duplicate economic transaction denied.
cases.required_evidence: Correlation identity, party ownership, contract version and idempotent mapping readback.

cases.title: Purpose-bound documentary exchange
cases.positive: Exact immutable contract/invoice/required evidence versions are disclosed to entitled external or tenant recipient with proof of delivery and authorised acknowledgements.
cases.negative: Wrong recipient, source-version swap, expired grant, consent/legal basis missing and public object links denied.
cases.required_evidence: Issuer/source, exact version hash, purpose, legal basis, delivery acknowledgement and revocation.

cases.title: Effective-dated regulatory and customs evidence
cases.positive: Correct direction/product/actor/time/source determines requirements and holds or authorised decisions, with customs releases evidenced by actual authority.
cases.negative: Unknown HS, absent official source, reverse-corridor rule reuse, inferred preference, synthetic clearance and stale permit denied.
cases.required_evidence: Rule/source/effective date, official source or qualified adapter, independent authority observation and denial.

cases.title: External non-tenant participation
cases.positive: A non-subscribing independently identified counterparty can transact through governed partner portal/API and documented acknowledgements.
cases.negative: External counterparty is forced into fake Tenant/DigitalEstate, impersonation, arbitrary identity merge or foreign tenant API admitted.
cases.required_evidence: Authenticated partner intent/contract, external recipient proof, no-tenant audit and identity negative.

cases.title: Applicable local accounting and provenance
cases.positive: Qualified participating enterprise's native ERP records authorised inventory, invoice, seller AR/revenue/COGS/FX or buyer AP/receipt when in buyer role.
cases.negative: Unqualified foreign AP falsely claimed, wrong AD_Client/AD_Org, double ledger, out-of-period or unbalanced posting rejected.
cases.required_evidence: Actual real PostgreSQL 17/iDempiere readback, legal actor pin, balances and source tie-out.

cases.title: Actual payment and settlement reconciliation
cases.positive: Separate payer/beneficiary-matched payment provider/bank outcome reconciles to ERP obligation with currency/rate/fees provenance.
cases.negative: ERP payment recording is treated as movement, unverified callback or unknown PSP outcome blindly retried, wrong destination paid.
cases.required_evidence: Provider attestation, webhook signature/idempotency, bank/payment observation and ledger reconciliation.

cases.title: Distributed failures compensation and replay
cases.positive: No cross-engine global DB transaction assumed; each local operation uses current authority and durable events, replays reconcile without duplicate economic effect.
cases.negative: Customs hold, carrier outage, rejected document, delayed PSP, crash recovery or duplicate event silently commits/erases history.
cases.required_evidence: Run-pinned owner outbox/inbox, negative rollback, compensation and teardown receipts.

cases.title: Strict isolation and verified recovery
cases.positive: Independent tenants and external recipients see only explicitly authorised scoped projections; permitted historical evidence retained and recoverable.
cases.negative: Nabhold ownership shortcut, revoked actor, data-leak, weak redaction, stale token, incomplete teardown or failed restore bypass rejected.
cases.required_evidence: Cross-tenant denial, privilege revocation, immutable audited custody, disaster restore and teardown.

cases.title: Agricultural origin and producer provenance
cases.positive: Verified supplier/cooperative/producer origin and lot source chain recorded with proper agency and personal data scope.
cases.negative: Unverified Kyagulanyi legal form, invented farmer ownership or cooperative representation, forged produce origins rejected.
cases.required_evidence: Source supplier/producer and rights evidence, origin lot/quality/custody lineage.

cases.title: Commodity collection procurement and quality
cases.positive: Sourcing contract, graded receipt, lot quantity, price basis, supplier payable and warehouse custody reconcile.
cases.negative: Duplicate/short/poor-grade receipt, quarantined lot, invalid source authority and excessive credit denied.
cases.required_evidence: Native receipt/ERP AP, quality grade, weight and contractual evidence with negative.

cases.title: Agricultural transformation and lot genealogy
cases.positive: Actual drying, milling, grading, sorting or blending (only where applicable) consumes input lots and records outputs, yield/loss and quality.
cases.negative: Invented processing, untraceable blended lots, impossible yield or quality hold release denied.
cases.required_evidence: Batch genealogy, QA release actor, input/output quantities and inventory valuation.

cases.title: Agricultural corridor requirement composition
cases.positive: Each claimed agricultural direction, product and effective date independently determines origin, phyto/SPS, export/import customs and documentary requirements; UG-to-ZA coffee is a reference, never authority for another corridor.
cases.negative: Industrial equipment tariff, unsupported country reversal, missing origin/permit or stale SPS evidence treated as clearance.
cases.required_evidence: Source-dated regulatory profile, official evidence and separate import/export decisions.

cases.title: Cooperative representation member data and related party
cases.positive: Cooperative officers represent only approved scope, member/producer information is minimised and potential BCU equity interest separately authorised.
cases.negative: Supplier role implies shareholding, membership implies individual consent, shareholder implies seller admin, or unqualified financier access denied.
cases.required_evidence: Representation and consent basis, independent SoD, role-bound source and disclosure negatives.

cases.title: Effective BOM routing and work order
cases.positive: Real iDempiere 13 release and qualified module establish BOM revision, routing and work order authority for the correct manufacturer.
cases.negative: Stale BOM, foreign plant/client, missing native classification, unqualified adapter or unauthorised work order refused.
cases.required_evidence: Pinned installed bundle/schema/commit, BOM version, authority and native deny-by-name test.

cases.title: Imported component stock and production genealogy
cases.positive: Imported/local inputs, receiving, duties/landed cost, material issue, WIP, scrap and serial/lot output reconcile.
cases.negative: Duplicated imported receipts, component without provenance, quarantined goods, over-consumption or duplicate serials denied.
cases.required_evidence: Real native stock moves, input/output genealogy, customs/source references and conservation evidence.

cases.title: Actual production costing and GL balance
cases.positive: Production output, WIP, quality holds, costs and Fact_Acct reconcile in native iDempiere with PostgreSQL 17 and correct legal actor.
cases.negative: Direct SQL bypass, foreign AD_Client, double-posting, unbalanced journal, unsupported cost method or stale period denied.
cases.required_evidence: Actual JVM/DB run, native transaction/fence, balanced posting and rollback.

cases.title: Manufactured origin and industrial conformity
cases.positive: Product-specific ZA→UG industrial tariff, transformation-origin rule, BOM/material source, inspection and UNBS applicability evaluated from current evidence.
cases.negative: South African assembly alone asserts AfCFTA preference, unknown HS/PVoC automatically approves or missing source grants clearance.
cases.required_evidence: Versioned rule/HS/effective date, BOM/value inputs, standard/product evidence and legal decision.

cases.title: Known supplier admitted without identity duplication
cases.positive: A lawfully represented existing verified Organisation is re-used during customer admission without creating a second verified canonical organisation.
cases.negative: Known organisation UUID alone authorises takeover, ambiguous natural-person/organisation status or forged representative accepted.
cases.required_evidence: Verified identity and representative proof, reconciliation, duplicate/hijack denial.

cases.title: Tenant-private commercial relationship preserved
cases.positive: ZuriBeans supplier relationship, historic contracts, qualification and pricing stay tenant-owned after BCU-like customer obtains independent PlatformAccount.
cases.negative: New tenant reads or rewrites ZuriBeans supplier qualification, correspondence, bank data, pricing or past order.
cases.required_evidence: Before/after tenant-private record hash, isolation and disclosure grant boundary.

cases.title: Independent subscription grants and offboarding
cases.positive: New unrelated COMMERCIAL tenant receives only separately approved subscription, grant and qualified provider; offboarding revokes without erasing records.
cases.negative: Became tenant implies Nabhold INTERNAL, group membership, shared issuer/resource grant or permanent data access.
cases.required_evidence: Two-tenant provider binding/readback, negative inherited grant and historic immutable custody.

cases.title: Independently qualified two-ledger financial proof
cases.positive: When BOTH parties separately consent and qualify ERP, seller AR/GL and buyer AP/GL reconcile through disclosed transaction evidence.
cases.negative: Non-Baobab buyer required to expose internal ledger, same shared row used twice, or buyer AP inferred from seller invoice.
cases.required_evidence: Separate native tenant/ERP/GL readbacks, matching disclosed invoice, settlement and independent principals.

cases.title: Heterogeneous provider interoperability
cases.positive: One party uses one CRM/ERP provider and another independently selects a different qualified provider without canonical ID mutation.
cases.negative: Vendor-native IDs leak as canonical IDs, migrations rewrite other tenant data or provider binding bypasses qualification.
cases.required_evidence: Distinct adapters/provider routing, canonical refs, contract parity and denial.

cases.title: Provider-neutral CRM relationship isolation
cases.positive: CRM lead/contact/account-view and service cases are scoped per enterprise, and cross-party disclosure requires explicit authority.
cases.negative: Salesforce or iDempiere record owner treated as CP Organisation or automatic cross-tenant CRM access.
cases.required_evidence: CRM adapter tenant selection, data rights, reconciliation, negative cross-scope queries.

cases.title: CRM opportunity to governed Trade commitment
cases.positive: Qualified CRM Opportunity creates only an idempotent Trade intent and current Trade-native buyer/seller authority governs order execution.
cases.negative: Opportunity Closed Won, sales manager approval or CRM automation alone creates financial or buyer commitment.
cases.required_evidence: Handoff reference, native Trade authorization, duplicate replay, denial reflected in CRM.

cases.title: Provider-qualified corridor booking
cases.positive: Current carrier/service capability and corridor/mode are resolved without mandatory Thamani participation.
cases.negative: Unqualified carrier, arbitrary route, wrong tenant, revoked partner or fake ETA becomes an accepted booking.
cases.required_evidence: Actual provider binding and signature, booking response and failed eligibility negative.

cases.title: Real shipment and movement observation
cases.positive: Physical consignment movement and state transitions carry verifiable provider-authenticated event, source time and custody.
cases.negative: Fake carrier webhook, duplicate booking, unobserved transit or unsupported route accepted as delivery.
cases.required_evidence: Authenticated movement, event replay, correlation and provider receipt.

cases.title: Custody exceptions POD and partial delivery
cases.positive: Handoffs, damage/partial delivery/dispute and proof-of-delivery document are independently evidenced.
cases.negative: Unverified receiving signature, unknown warehouse custody or partial damage silently billed as full delivery.
cases.required_evidence: POD issuer, receipt/version, quantity variance, insurer/carrier exception trace.

cases.title: Freight landed-cost reconciliation
cases.positive: Qualified freight/insurance/duty charges are matched to applicable ERP cost/AR/AP by source and currency while TMS owns no GL.
cases.negative: Estimated freight treated actual, fees doubled, FX source missing or carrier invoice overrides ledger.
cases.required_evidence: Actual cost components, authorised ERP posting, variance and idempotent reconciliation.
